dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: At first glance, this camp seems organized along arbitrary lines. But on closer inspection, the underlying principles become clear. I would even say they are rather inspiring.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Was this an accidental achievement on your part? Or have you studied the art of war in great depth?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Either way, in accordance with established military convention, those who demonstrate outstanding capabilities ought to be rewarded.
